status.name: terminal.output
status.description: The output lines of the terminal surface, without line terminators.

status.name: terminal.screen
status.description: The output lines currently visible, the number of lines that fit in the output area, and its scroll position in CSS pixels.

status.name: terminal.cwd
status.description: The current directory the shell session last reported, or null before the first report.

status.name: terminal.runs
status.description: The number of terminal.run commands delivered to the shell session that have not finished.

commands.name: terminal.write
commands.description: Writes text to the shell session: to the running command's input while a command runs, otherwise as the next command.

commands.name: terminal.run
commands.description: Runs a command once in the session's current directory without changing the session, and returns its merged output and exit status.

commands.name: terminal.interrupt
commands.description: Sends the interrupt signal to the command the session is running and to running terminal.run commands.

commands.name: terminal.clear
commands.description: Removes all output lines from the terminal surface.

dom.name: terminal.interrupt
dom.description: The button that interrupts the running command.

dom.name: terminal.clear
dom.description: The button that clears the output.
